root_causes.description: Recommendation service exhibits extreme memory pressure (z=+122.56) far exceeding other services, indicating potential OOM risk or memory leak causing cascading failures
Currency service shows extreme p99 latency anomaly (z>1000) with p99=6.401ms vs baseline of 1.98ms, indicating severe latency degradation affecting dependent services
Payment service shows significant memory pressure (z=+10.97) with working set at 1.329e+08 bytes vs baseline of 1.311e+08±1.7e+05, indicating growing memory usage contributing to instability

remediation_steps: Investigate recommendation pod for memory leak or increase memory limits
Review currency service latency dependencies and optimize slow paths
Apply memory pressure monitoring and alerts for payment service
